title: Honeyjar offers AI tools to improve PR and comms at every company
slides: Can AI fix your PR agency's biggest headache?
Honeyjar launches AI tools for PR and comms.
It targets mundane tasks, not big strategy.
Your team could reclaim hours each week.
But can AI truly handle nuanced pitches?
thread_text:
1. AI Won't Steal Your Job — But This Might

Honeyjar just launched AI tools for public relations and communications teams. They target the boring stuff, not the big strategy.

2. The Real Problem Isn't Strategy

Most PR teams don't struggle with the big pitch. They drown in media lists, follow-ups, and repetitive admin work that eats hours every single week.

3. Where the Hours Actually Go

Honeyjar's AI handles the mundane tasks so your team can focus on relationships and creative angles. That's potentially hours back per person, per week.

4. But Here's the Catch

Can AI really handle a nuanced pitch to a skeptical journalist? That's the question no tool has answered yet — and it's the one that matters most.

5. Test It Before You Trust It

Take one real pitch you're working on and run it through an AI tool this week. If you still have to rewrite it twice, you have your answer.
